blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tracking seasonal change in crops and forests requires observing the same plants repeatedly. Ground robots can do this at close range, and a manipulator gives their sensors more viewpoints. Yet the robots behind long-term field datasets are rarely released with their design files, and how a robot’s own structure limits arm reach and occludes its sensors is seldom compared between builds. We present ALFRED, an open-source mobile manipulator built from commercially available components. It carries a six-degree-of-freedom arm, LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, RTK GNSS and an IMU on an Ackermann-steered base, all mounted on a reconfigurable aluminium strut frame, and runs containerised ROS software. It was developed through four builds against six requirements for repeated outdoor deployment: durability, modularity, repairability, sensing reach, endurance and reproducibility. Model-based analysis of the last three builds shows the usable share of the arm’s reachable poses rising from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, and ray casting shows that only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR’s horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals) without missing a scheduled collection. This was despite battery degradation, reconfiguration for another researcher’s study, and the parallel development of ALFRED 2.0 for autonomous crop-row operation, with each switch between builds taking about six hours. The deployment also showed that mechanical modularity is only as dependable as the robot description that tracks it. Design files, bill of materials, robot descriptions, containers and build documentation are openly released.
blocks.zh: 跟踪作物和森林的季节变化需要反复观察同样的植物。 地面机器人可以近距离完成这项工作,操纵者会给他们的传感器更多的视角. 然而,长期野外数据集背后的机器人很少随其设计文件一同发布,机器人自身的结构如何限制手臂的伸展,如何占用其传感器也很少在建筑之间进行比较。 我们介绍ALFRED,一个开源移动操纵器,由商业上可用的组件建造. 它搭载一个六度自由臂,LiDAR,RGB-D相机,RTK GNSS和一台IMU在Ackermann-steered的基座上,均安装在可重塑的铝支架上,并运行集装箱式ROS软件. 它是通过四栋建筑来开发的,这六栋建筑是用于重复室外部署的:耐久性、模块性、可修复性、感应力、耐久性和可复制性。 基于模型的对最后三栋建筑的分析显示,臂的可伸缩部分从34.0%升至60.0%,然后升至66.1%,射线铸造显示只有最后的建筑能保持帧式LiDAR的横向视野,既清晰又清晰。 ALFRED完成了一年的月度森林调查(528 transversal),没有遗漏预定的采集. 尽管电池退化、对另一名研究人员的研究进行重组、同时开发ALFRED 2.0用于自主的作物种植操作,但每个开关在建筑之间需要大约6小时。 部署还显示,机械模块化仅能与跟踪它的机器人描述一样可靠. 设计文件,材料单,机器人描述,容器和建设文件公开发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Crop growth models simulate crop development from weather, soil and management practices, but numerous uncertainties compromise their performance ( Dlamini et al., 2023 ) . Data assimilation can reduce this uncertainty using in-season measurements of crop traits ( Huang et al., 2016 ) . Acquiring those measurements conventionally requires manual and often destructive sampling, which is slow, labour-intensive and costly ( Atefi et al., 2021 ) . Destructive sampling is also unsuitable for monitoring a crop continuously through its growth cycle: the plant is removed or damaged, and the gap it leaves alters the plants either side of it, which partially compensate for its loss ( Pavek and Thornton, 2006 ) . Non-destructive measurement, by contrast, allows the same plants to be measured repeatedly and their growth tracked over time ( Poorter et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 作物生长模型从天气、土壤和管理做法模拟作物发展,但许多不确定因素影响了作物的性能(Dlamini等人,2023年)。 数据同化可以通过季节内测量作物特征来减少这种不确定性(Huang等人,2016年)。 取得这些测量通常需要人工取样,而且往往具有破坏性,这种取样过程缓慢、劳力密集且费用高昂(Atefi等人,2021年)。 破坏性取样也不适合对作物的整个生长周期进行连续监测:植物被移除或损坏,它留下的缺口会改变植物的两边,从而部分补偿其损失(Pavek和Shornton,2006年)。 相比之下,无损测量使同样的植物能够反复测量,并随着时间推移跟踪其生长情况(Poorter等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Satellites and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) both provide in-season observations for crop model data assimilation, and each makes a different trade-off between coverage and detail ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . Satellites cover whole regions, but their resolution is coarse and cloud cover can leave long gaps between usable images during the growing season ( Matese et al., 2015 ; Whitcraft et al., 2015 ) .UAVs offer finer spatial resolution and more flexible revisits than satellites, at the cost of coverage ( Bazrafkan et al., 2025 ) . However, they view the crop from above or at an oblique angle, so lower leaves, stems and internal canopy structure are often occluded in dense or tall crops ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Low-altitude multi-rotor flight adds a further problem, since rotor downwash can deform flexible plants and alter the canopy geometry being measured Shi et al. (2021) . Unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) do not suffer from the same issue and can sense plants at close range, where more information can be acquired about individual organs, and adding a manipulator allows cameras to be positioned and oriented at the best viewpoints ( Atefi et al., 2021 ) . Because the end effector can be swapped, a single mobile manipulator can be reconfigured for different tasks ( Guri et al., 2024 ) , allowing several kinds of data to be collected from the same plants. This article focuses on mobile manipulators of this kind.
blocks.zh: 卫星和无人驾驶飞行器都为作物模型数据同化提供季内观测,并且各自在覆盖范围和细节之间作出不同的权衡(Wang等人,2024年). 卫星覆盖整个区域,但其分辨率粗糙,云层覆盖,在生长季节,可用图像之间可能留下很长的空白(Matese等人,2015年;Whitcraft等人,2015年)。 无人驾驶飞行器提供的空间分辨率更细,比卫星更灵活地重访,其代价是覆盖范围(Bazrafkan等人,2025年)。 然而,它们从上方或偏斜的角度看待作物,因此下层的叶子,茎和内层的树冠结构常常被覆盖在茂密或高大的作物中(张等人,2026年). 低海拔多旋翼飞行又增加了一个问题,因为转子下洗可以使柔性植物变形,并改变正在测量的树冠几何(Shi等人)(2021年). 无人驾驶地面车辆(UGVs)不受同一问题的影响,可以近距离感知植物,在那里可以获得更多关于单个器官的信息,并添加一个操纵器,可以让摄像机定位和导向最佳视角(Atefi等人,2021年). 由于端效应器可以互换,因此可以重新配置一个单一的移动操纵器来完成不同的任务(Guri等人,2024年),从而可以从同一植物中收集几种数据. 本文主要介绍此类移动操纵者.

blocks.en: Long-term experiments and data collection place additional demands on the platform. The platform must be able to operate outdoors all year round, be reconfigurable as sensing requirements change, and maintainable and repairable. Further demands arise when the platform is needed for other experiments, as happens when it is shared between projects, or during planned upgrades, which must be built and validated without missing scheduled data collections. Existing research shows that long-term deployment of agricultural robots is achievable ( Bender et al., 2020 ; Polvara et al., 2024 ) , as are modular platforms ( Grimstad and From, 2017 ; Guri et al., 2024 ) . However, these studies rarely discuss the rapid prototyping required before and during sustained, repeated deployment, or compare successive prototype builds against desirable characteristics to quantify their improvements. Additionally, reachability analysis ( Zacharias et al., 2007 ; Vahrenkamp et al., 2013 ) and LiDAR placement ( Kim and Park, 2020 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) are common tools in manipulation and autonomous driving, but are rarely used as development tools to compare agricultural robot prototypes.
blocks.zh: 长期实验和数据收集对平台提出了额外的要求. 该平台必须能够全年在户外运行,随着感知要求的改变可以重新配置,并且可以维护和修复。 当其他实验需要该平台时,如项目之间共享时,或计划升级时,则会出现进一步的需求,而升级必须建造和验证,而不遗漏预定的数据收集。 现有研究表明,农业机器人的长期部署是可以实现的(Bender等人,2020年;Polvara等人,2024年),模块平台也是如此(Grimstad and From,2017年;Guri等人,2024年)。 然而,这些研究很少讨论在持续、重复部署之前和期间所需的快速原型,或对照可取的特性比较相继建造的原型,以量化改进。 此外,可达性分析(Zacharias等人,2007年;Vahrenkamp等人,2013年)和LiDAR放置(Kim and Park,2020年;Hu等人,2022年)是操纵和自主驾驶的常见工具,但很少被用作开发工具来比较农业机器人原型.

blocks.en: This paper presents the Autonomous Leaf and Forestry Research Exploration Device (ALFRED), a mobile manipulator assembled from commercially available components for repeated close-range sensing of crops and forests. It was developed through four builds, each motivated by a requirement its predecessor failed to meet, against six design requirements: outdoor durability, modularity and reconfigurability, repairability, sensing reach and coverage, endurance, and reproducibility by others. The last two builds are ALFRED, an aluminium strut-frame robot that collected a year of monthly forest surveys, and ALFRED 2.0, which adds a second frame layer, a second computer and real-time kinematic (RTK) positioning for autonomous crop-row operation. Since the authors had no access to farmland, forestry served as a proxy, testing the platform’s ability to capture seasonal and structural change in living plants over a full annual cycle. For the same reason, ALFRED 2.0’s crop-row operation used artificial plants set out in rows in a field.
blocks.zh: 本文件介绍了自主叶片和林业研究勘探装置,这是一个从商业上可用的组件组装的移动操纵器,用于对作物和森林进行反复近距离探测。 它通过四座建筑发展而成,每座建筑的动机是其前身未能满足一项要求,而六项设计要求是:室外耐久性、模块性和再适应性、可修复性、感知范围和覆盖面、耐久性以及他人的再生产。 最后两座建筑是ALFRED,一个收集了一年月度森林调查的铝结构机器人,以及ALFRED 2.0,它增加了一个第二帧层,第二个计算机和实时动能(RTK)定位,用于自主的作物行进操作. 由于提交人无法进入农田,林业成为代用工具,检验了该平台在全年周期内捕捉活植物季节性和结构性变化的能力。 出于同样的原因,ALFRED 2.0的作物种植操作使用了田间连续排列的人工植物.

blocks.en: The contributions of this article are: 1. the presentation of a modular platform used in three experiments in the course of a year all requiring significantly different builds while not missing scheduled data collection in a year long experiment 2. a requirement-traced account of the four builds, recording the failure behind each design change 3. a model-based comparison of the last three builds, in which the usable share of the arm’s reachable workspace rises from 34.0% to 60.0% and 66.1%, and the visibility of the frame-mounted LiDAR is compared across build, task, and arm posture 4. an open release of the design files, robot description, and containerised software
blocks.zh: 本条的贡献是: 1. 一年中在三个实验中使用的模块化平台的介绍 所有需要显著不同的构建,同时在一年长的实验中不遗漏预定的数据收集 2. 要求跟踪的四栋建筑的叙述,记录每个设计变化背后的故障 3. 基于模型的后三栋建筑的比较,其中臂可伸缩工作空间的可用份额从34.0%上升到60.0%和66.1%,帧式LiDAR的能见度在构建、任务和臂姿势4之间进行比较.

blocks.en: The remainder of this article is structured as follows. Section 2 reviews data assimilation into crop models, mobile manipulators for repeated crop sensing, and the use of reachability and visibility analysis as design tools. Section 3 introduces ALFRED and ALFRED 2.0 together with the ForestYear3D and ROWCAST experiments they were built for, and Section 4 describes the hardware and software shared by both builds and the differences between them. Section 5 states the six design requirements and Section 6 introduces the four prototypes. Sections 7 to 10.4 then assess every build against each requirement in turn, including the model-based comparison of manipulator reach and sensor visibility in Section 10 . Section 11 sets out the limitations and future work, and Section 12 concludes.
blocks.zh: 本条其余部分的结构如下。 第2节审查将数据同化到作物模型、用于重复作物感知的移动操纵器以及将可达到性和能见度分析用作设计工具。 第3节介绍了ALFRED和ALFRED 2.0以及它们为建造的森林年3D和ROWCAST实验,第4节介绍了两个建筑共用的硬件和软件以及它们之间的差异。 第5节规定了六项设计要求,第6节介绍了四项原型。 然后,第7至10.4节对照每项要求评估每一项建筑,包括第10节中基于模型的操纵器的能见度和传感器可见度比较。 第11节规定了限制和未来的工作,第12节结束。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Data assimilation into crop models
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据融入作物模式

blocks.en: Assimilating in-season observations can reduce the error between crop model estimates and in-field observations ( Dlamini et al., 2023 ) . Assimilating leaf area index into WOFOST, Curnel et al. (2011) found that accurate weekly observations throughout the season are required to halve yield error. Their experiments used synthetic data, because assessing an assimilation scheme against real observations requires more observations than can be collected. However, the weight of each observation is not uniform throughout the season. Assimilating a single Sentinel-2 leaf area index estimate from tillering, or from booting to flowering, matched or bettered the biomass simulated from assimilating several estimates taken during stem elongation ( Tewes et al., 2020 ) . These phenological windows are short, and their dates are unknown in advance. On calibrated data, Wallach et al. (2021) tested the ability of 27 modelling groups to predict phenology in wheat, the best model had a mean absolute error of around three days. An error of a few days in the date of a window that is itself only days wide means the informative observation cannot be scheduled reliably in advance. Capturing it requires sampling densely enough around the expected stage to bracket that uncertainty, rather than relying on a single well-timed acquisition. Satellite records cannot guarantee this, because revisit is fixed and acquisitions are lost to cloud ( Whitcraft et al., 2015 ) , and the accuracy requirement compounds the difficulty. A ground robot answers both: it can be sent out on the days that matter rather than when an orbit allows, and it observes the canopy at close range and from viewpoints that platforms above the crop cannot reach.
blocks.zh: 将季间观测同化可以减少作物模型估计和实地观测之间的误差(Dlamini等人,2023年)。 将叶片面积指数同化为WOFOST,Curnel等人(2011年)发现,整个季节都需要精确的周观测,才能将产量误差减半. 他们的实验使用了合成数据,因为对照真实的观测来评估同化计划需要的观测比收集得还要多. 然而,每个观察的重量在整个赛季并不统一. 将单一的Sentinel-2叶面积指数估计从耕作,或从开动到开花,进行同化,比对或改进了干燥延展期间的几个估计数中模拟的生物量(Tewes等人,2020年)。 这些phenology窗口很短,其日期事先未知. 在校准数据上,Wallach等人(2021年)测试了27个建模组在小麦中预测phenology的能力,最好的模型有大约3天的平均绝对误差. 窗口日期中几天的误差本身只有几天的误差,意味着信息性观察无法可靠地提前安排. 要抓住它,就需要在预期阶段周围进行足够密集的取样,以区分这种不确定性,而不是依赖一次及时的获取。 卫星记录无法保证这一点,因为重访是固定的,采购输给了云(Whitcraft等人,2015年),准确性要求加重了难度. 一个地面机器人回答两个问题:它可以在重要的日子发出,而不是在轨道允许的时候发出,它从作物上方的平台无法达到的视角近距离观察树冠.

blocks.en: 2.2 Mobile manipulators for long-term crop sensing
blocks.zh: 2.2 用于长期作物感测的移动操纵器

blocks.en: Ground robots can carry heavier sensors and provide more viewing angles than aerial platforms when measuring traits at the plant and organ level ( Xu and Li, 2022 ) . These measurements are non-destructively and repeatable at several time points through a growing season ( Atefi et al., 2021 ) . Xu and Li (2022) state that a challenge for phenotyping robots is they are often designed for one crop and field layout and do not generalise to other crops or layouts. Even within the same crop and layout perception systems can suffer. Burusa et al. (2024) claim that perception systems in greenhouses generalise poorly to variation and struggle with issues such as occlusion. They address this issue through the use of a manipulator and an end-effector mounted RGB-D camera deployed upon a cart which could be manoeuvred around the greenhouse.
blocks.zh: 地面机器人在测量植物和器官的特征时,可以携带较重的传感器,提供比航空平台更多的取景角度(徐和李,2022). 这些测量是无损的,在生长季节的几个时间点上可以重复(Atefi等人,2021年). 徐和李(2022年)称,麻黄机器人的一个挑战在于,它们常常是针对一种作物和田间布局设计的,并不泛指其他作物或布局. 即使在同一作物和布局感知系统内,也可能受到影响。 布鲁萨等人. (2024年)称温室的感知系统普遍不善于变化,与隔离等问题作斗争. 他们通过使用一台操纵器和装在车上的装有RGB-D的终端效应照相机来解决这一问题,这台照相机可以在温室周围机动。

blocks.en: Repeated observation of the same vegetation has been demonstrated over many months, with sensors carried by hand ( Knights et al., 2022 ) , backpack ( Malladi et al., 2025 ) and on ground robots carrying fixed sensors ( Bender et al., 2020 ; Polvara et al., 2024 ; Boxan et al., 2026 ) . The demands placed on these robots range from battery problems cutting deployments short ( Boxan et al., 2026 ) to map reuse degradation in vineyards as the crop grows ( Polvara et al., 2024 ) . To the best of the authors’ knowledge, however, no in-field campaign has monitored the same plants across a full growing season using a mobile manipulator, and none reports the design requirements the platform was built against or releases the information needed to rebuild it.
blocks.zh: 在许多月中,对同一植被的反复观测得到证明,传感器由手携带(Knights等人,2022年),背包携带(Malladi等人,2025年),地面机器人携带固定传感器(Bender等人,2020年;Polvara等人,2024年;Boxan等人,2026年)。 对这些机器人的需求从电池问题缩短部署(Boxan等人,2026年)到绘制葡萄园中作物生长后再利用退化图(Polvara等人,2024年)不等。 然而,据作者所知,没有开展实地宣传活动,利用移动操纵器在整个生长季节监测同一工厂,也没有人报告平台的设计要求与重建平台所需的信息相对应或发布。

blocks.en: 2.3 Reachability and visibility as design tools
blocks.zh: 2.3 可达到性和能见度作为设计工具

blocks.en: When designing a mobile manipulator for in-field plant monitoring it is useful to quantify the sensor coverage a build provides. Coverage here has two components: the set of poses at which the manipulator can place a sensor, which is a question of reachability, and what the frame-mounted sensors can see from the vehicle, which is a question of visibility. Both can be computed from a model of the robot before it is built, and the tools for doing so are established elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 在设计用于实地工厂监测的移动操纵器时,有必要量化一个建筑物提供的传感器覆盖范围。 这里的覆盖包含两个部分:操纵者可以放置传感器的一组姿势,这是一个可达性问题,以及帧挂传感器从飞行器上可以看到什么,这是一个能见度问题. 两者都可以在机器人建成前从模型中计算出来,而这样做的工具则在其他地方建立.

blocks.en: Reachability is commonly represented as a capability map, which records where and in which orientations an arm can reach ( Zacharias et al., 2007 ) , and inverting such a map yields the base positions from which a target is reachable ( Vahrenkamp et al., 2013 ) . Agriculture applies this at the design stage with Van Henten et al. (2009) selecting a manipulator’s kinematic structure by evaluating candidate configurations against the collision-free workspace the crop demands, and Bloch et al. (2018) co-designed orchard architecture together with the robot. In both cases the analysis was performed to test the ability of the arm to interact with the environment, rather than evaluate sensor coverage.
blocks.zh: 可达性通常表现为一种能力图,它记录臂能到达的地点和方向(Zacharias等人,2007年),反转这种图产生可达目标的基位(Vahrenkamp等人,2013年)。 Bloch等人(2018年)与机器人共同设计果园建筑。 在这两种情况下,都进行了分析,以测试臂与环境互动的能力,而不是评估传感器的覆盖范围。

blocks.en: Visibility is treated in the same spirit in autonomous driving, where the placement of one or more LiDAR units is optimised against sensing coverage ( Kim and Park, 2020 ) and against downstream object detection ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . Since the carrier is a rigid body, self-occlusion is identical in every scan. This however does not hold for the mobile manipulator where the largest occluder is the arm that moves independently of the vehicle. Therefore the field of view depends on posture as well as on mounting position. The two components are also coupled, because the structure mounted around the arm that limits its reach is largely the same structure that blocks the vehicle’s own LiDAR, so a change intended to improve one alters the other.
blocks.zh: 可见度在自主驾驶时受到同样精神的对待,其中对一个或多个LiDAR单位的布置进行优化防感覆盖(Kim and Park,2020年)和下游物体探测(Hu等人,2022年). 由于载体是一个刚性的身体,因此每次扫描中自我隔离都是相同的. 然而,对于移动操纵器来说,这一点并不重要,因为最大的操作器是独立于车辆移动的手臂。 因此,视场既取决于姿态,也取决于位置的上升。 这两部分也是结合的,因为限制其伸展的臂部周围的架设结构基本上与阻挡车辆自身LiDAR的结构相同,所以为了改进一个而作的改变会改变另一个结构.

blocks.en: This paper reports one mobile manipulator developed through four builds against six requirements, deployed monthly for a year and rebuilt for autonomous crop-row operation while that year was still running. Reachability and visibility are computed on the robot descriptions to compare successive builds before anything is manufactured, and the design files, robot descriptions and containerised software are released.
blocks.zh: 本文报告通过四栋楼按6项要求开发的1台移动操纵机,每月部署一年,并在当年仍在运行时重建用于自主作物种植作业。 在机器人描述上计算出可达到性和可见度,以在制造任何东西之前比较连续的建筑,并发布设计文件,机器人描述和容器化软件.

blocks.en: 3 The ALFRED robots
blocks.zh: 3个ALFRED机器人

blocks.en: ALFRED was designed to collect the data needed to improve crop model predictions through data assimilation over multiple growing seasons. The platform is modular because it is shared between several researchers and must change as experimental requirements change, so components need to be added or removed quickly. A mobile manipulator was chosen because sensor placement must change as plants grow, and improving crop model predictions is likely to require several sensors, each with its own placement requirements. Two versions of the platform have been deployed: ALFRED in a year-long forest campaign and ALFRED 2.0 in crop-row trials.
blocks.zh: ALFRED旨在收集所需的数据,通过多生长季节的数据同化改进作物模型预测。 该平台是模块化的,因为它由多个研究者共享,必须随着实验要求的改变而改变,因此需要快速添加或移除组件. 选择移动操纵器是因为传感器的放置必须随着植物的生长而改变,改进作物模型预测很可能需要几个传感器,每个传感器都有自己的放置要求. 该平台有两个版本已经部署:一个是为期一年的森林运动中的ALFRED,另一个是农作物种植试验中的ALFRED 2.0。

blocks.en: ALFRED 2.0 (Figure 3 ) was used in the ROWCAST experiments, which automate the collection of row-crop phenotyping data. ROWCAST exploits the semi-static layout of crop rows. A one-off commissioning step establishes the row layout and planting density and uses a costmap to generate a base path that avoids the crops. At each measurement date, the robot then runs a scout-plan-execute-phenotype loop: a fast LiDAR-only scout builds an occupancy map, RGB-D camera viewpoints are planned by ray casting against this map, the plan is executed in the field, and phenotypes are extracted from the collected data. Figure 4 shows RGB-D point clouds of two artificial plants, which are of sufficient quality to extract geometric traits such as plant height, width and canopy cover. Further details are available on the project website .
blocks.zh: ALFRED 2.0(图3)被用于ROWCAST实验中,该实验将收集的行-作物杂交数据自动化. ROWCAST利用作物行的半静态布局. 一次性调试步骤确定行布局和栽培密度,并使用成本图生成避免作物的基路径. 在每个测量日,机器人再运行一个侦察-计划-执行-苯基型循环:一个快速的LiDAR-唯一探测者构建一个占用图,RGB-D相机视距通过射线铸造来规划与这个地图相对应,计划在外地执行,从收集的数据中提取苯基型. 图4显示两个人工植物的RGB-D点云,其质量足以提取植物高度,宽度和冠盖等几何特征. 详情见项目网站。

blocks.en: Both builds run ROS 1 Noetic in Docker containers with a two-layer architecture: a base image holds the core robot configuration, drivers and dependencies, and application images built on top hold the planning and behaviour components Varpe et al. (2025) . Containerisation was adopted for reproducibility, portability and environment isolation, since the control laptop was shared with another researcher Kadri et al. (2022) ; Varpe et al. (2025) . The layered structure also shortens build times and lets experimental behaviours be developed without altering the core system.

blocks.en: 4.2 ALFRED: ForestYear3D configuration
blocks.zh: 4.2 ALFRED:森林年3D配置

blocks.en:
During the ForestYear3D campaign, ALFRED carried both LiDARs, with the frame-mounted unit operating at 1024 × 10 Hz 1024\times$10\text{\,}\mathrm{Hz}$ and the end-effector unit at 2048 × 10 Hz 2048\times$10\text{\,}\mathrm{Hz}$ . The 1.590 kg 1.590\text{\,}\mathrm{kg} end-effector payload comprised the manipulator interface, the sensor mount, the arm-mounted LiDAR with its base and radial heatsinks, and two RGB-D cameras. Inertial data was recorded from the InertialSense unit, at X for calibrated readings and 1kHz for raw readings, and from the internal IMUs of both LiDARs. The GNSS receiver was carried but not used, because RTK had not been commissioned by the last date on which a full annual cycle of collection could begin; this was a low priority, as forest corridors are GNSS-degraded environments (
              ) . Each traversal was recorded as a ROS bag containing the sensor, robot-state, control and transform streams needed to replay the acquisition and rerun the reconstruction.

blocks.en: Operation was semi-autonomous. The manipulator autonomously swept between fixed joint configurations, while the base moved at a constant commanded velocity and an operator following the robot steered it. This removed any dependence on SLAM performing robustly across the seasonal and structural changes in the forest.
blocks.zh: 行动是半自主的。 操纵器在固定联合配置之间自动扫荡,而基地以恒定的指令速度移动,操作员在机器人引导后移动. 这消除了对苏丹解放军和苏丹解放军在森林季节和结构变化中表现强劲的依赖。

blocks.en: 4.3 ALFRED 2.0: ROWCAST configuration
blocks.zh: 4.3 ALFRED 2.0: ROWCST配置

blocks.en: ALFRED 2.0 was built for autonomous crop-row monitoring. A second onboard laptop and a WiFi router were added, which required a second frame layer and a larger network switch. The arm-mounted LiDAR was removed to reduce data volume and to cut the end-effector payload to 0.530 kg 0.530\text{\,}\mathrm{kg} . The two D457 cameras on opposite sides of the arm payload became the primary sensors, recording at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 or 848 × 480 848\times 480 in separate experiments, while the frame-mounted LiDAR ran at 2048 × 10 Hz 2048\times$10\text{\,}\mathrm{Hz}$ throughout. The base navigates autonomously along a pre-validated route, using Hybrid A* with a Timed Elastic Band local planner and a semantic pure-pursuit controller. As on ALFRED, manipulator motions are joint trajectories planned offline and checked for self-collision before deployment.
blocks.zh: 萨尔瓦多 2.0是用于自主作物种植监测的。 增加了第二个机载笔记本电脑和一个WiFi路由器,这需要第二个帧层和一个更大的网络开关. 臂载的LiDAR被移除,以减少数据体积,并将终端有效载荷削减到0.530公斤0.530\text~,}\mathrm{kg}. 位于臂载荷两侧的两台D457相机成为主传感器,分别记录在1280×720 1280\times 720或848×480 848\times 480的实验中,而装帧的LiDAR运行于2048×10 Hz 2048\times 10\times text§, {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}全程都是美元 该基地沿着预先验证的路线自主导航,使用Hybrid A*,配有Timed Elastic Band 本地规划器和语义纯纯净服控制器. 与ALFRED一样,操纵者运动是联合轨道,计划下线,在部署前检查是否自沉。

blocks.en: The second laptop, an MSI Stealth GS77 12UGS (Intel Core i7-12700H, 32 GB 32\text{\,}\mathrm{GB} memory, 1 TB 1\text{\,}\mathrm{TB} disk, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti), was added for three reasons. First, the primary laptop lacked the free ports to run the two arm-mounted cameras. Second, ALFRED 2.0 was intended to plan online, and this computation was to be kept separate from the control loop. Third, its GPU would make onboard semantic and instance segmentation feasible. Only the first was realised: the online planner was not brought into service in the time available (Section 11.3 ), and no learning-based perception ran onboard.
blocks.zh: 第二台笔记本电脑是MSI隐形GS77 12UGS(Intel Core i7-12700H,32 GB 32\text~,}\mathrm{GB}内存,1 TB 1\text~,}\mathrm{TB}磁盘,NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti),由于三个原因被添加. 首先,主手提电脑缺乏自由端口来运行两台臂载相机. 其次,ALFRED 2.0是打算在网上进行规划的,这种计算应与控制循环分开. 第三,它的GPU将使船上的语义和实例分割成为可行。 只有第一个目标得以实现:在线规划人员没有在可用时间内投入服务(第11.3节),而且没有基于学习的观念。

blocks.en: The WiFi router enables RTK positioning, since a standalone GNSS fix is accurate only to metres, which is coarse relative to the scale of a crop row. A dedicated radio link is the conventional and more robust choice for RTK corrections, but WiFi was adopted because it serves a second purpose at no extra hardware cost: it makes the onboard computers reachable from an operator laptop at the field edge, so a session can be started, monitored and visualised remotely. The operator laptop is an Alienware m16 R1 (Intel Core i9-13900HX, 64 GB 64\text{\,}\mathrm{GB} memory, 4 TB 4\text{\,}\mathrm{TB} disk). All three laptops run their robot software in ROS Noetic Docker containers.
blocks.zh: WiFi路由器使RTK定位成为可能,因为独立的GNSS固定装置的精确度仅为米,与作物行的规模相比是粗糙的。 专用无线电连接是RTK校正的常规和更强健的选择,但WiFi之所以被采用,是因为它服务于第二个目的,没有额外的硬件成本:它使机上计算机从外地边缘的操作员笔记本电脑可以到达,因此一个会话可以启动,监控和可视化远程. 运营商笔记本电脑是一台异形软件m16 R1(Intel Core i9-13900HX,64 GB 64\text~,Q}\mathrm{GB}内存,4 TB 4\text~,X}\mathrm{TB}磁盘). 所有三台笔记本电脑都在ROS Noetic Docker容器中运行他们的机器人软件.

blocks.en: With three computers on wired and wireless links, every interface was given a fixed address. The Dell laptop remains the ROS master because it carries the safety-critical interfaces. Figure 6 shows the network topology.
blocks.zh: 由于有线和无线链接有三台计算机,每个接口都得到了固定的地址. 戴尔笔记本电脑仍然是ROS主机,因为它搭载了安全关键接口. 图6显示了网络地形。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Network topology of ALFRED 2.0. Colour distinguishes computers, network hubs, control hardware, and sensors used in the reported experiments from those carried but not used. Line style distinguishes Ethernet, USB, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connections. The wireless link carries RTK correction messages from the base station to the rover.
blocks.zh: 图6:ALFRED2.0的网络地形. 颜色区分了所报告实验中使用的计算机、网络枢纽、控制硬件和传感器与所携带但未使用的计算机。 线条样式区分以太网,USB,Wi-Fi和蓝牙连接. 无线链接将RTK修正消息从基站传送到rover.

blocks.en: 5 Design requirements
blocks.zh: 5 设计要求

blocks.en: Both robots were built iteratively against six design requirements, listed below and followed by a discussion of how they shaped the four builds of the platform (Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh: 这两台机器人都是根据6个设计要求迭代建造的,以下列出,随后讨论了它们如何塑造平台的4个建筑(图7 ).

blocks.en: The platform must operate unsheltered across a full annual cycle without loss of function. It must survive unforecast light rain or gusts mid-session, tolerate mud, dust, pollen, humidity and the site’s annual temperature range, and traverse fallen leaves, loose stones and exposed roots.
blocks.zh: 该平台必须在整个年度周期内运行,不得失去功能。 它必须活过未预见到的轻雨或中风,容忍泥土、灰尘、花粉、湿度和场地年温范围,并穿越落叶、松散的石头和暴露的根部。

blocks.en: Sensors, computers and other mounted hardware must be relocatable and replaceable without significant redesign, so the platform can be reconfigured as sensing requirements change and shared with other researchers.
blocks.zh: 传感器,计算机和其他挂载的硬件必须可以重新调用和替换,而不进行重大的重新设计,因此平台可以随着感知要求的改变而重新配置,并与其他研究人员共享.

blocks.en: Failures must be repairable in-house between scheduled deployments, using commercially available components or parts made with available workshop equipment.
blocks.zh: 故障必须在计划部署之间内部进行修复,使用商业可用的部件或配有车间设备的部件。

blocks.en: The platform must place sensors at poses a rigidly mounted sensor cannot reach, and provide enough base-mounted field of view for each task.
blocks.zh: 平台必须把传感器置于一个刚性安装的传感器无法到达的位置上,并为每项任务提供足够的基载视野。

blocks.en: The platform must complete a scheduled data collection session without being limited by battery capacity.
blocks.zh: 平台必须完成预定的数据收集会议,而不受电池容量的限制。

blocks.en: A third party must be able to rebuild the platform: bespoke components manufacturable from released design files, other components commercially available and priced, and the software stack portable across machines.
blocks.zh: 第三方必须能够重建平台:从已发布的设计文件中标出可制造的组件、商业上可获得和定价的其他组件以及跨机器的软件堆栈。

blocks.zh: (b) 原型1

blocks.en: 6 Platform development
blocks.zh: 6 平台开发

blocks.en: This section assesses the four builds shown in Figure 7 (Prototype 0, Prototype 1, ALFRED and ALFRED 2.0) against the design requirements, as summarised in Figure 8 . All four are presented as prototypes rather than finished products, since many components could be further optimised and validated.
blocks.zh: 本节对照图8概述的设计要求,评估了图7(原型0、原型1、ALFRED和ALFRED2.0)所示的四座建筑。 由于许多部件可以进一步优化和验证,所以这四个部件都作为原型而不是成品。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Each of the four builds assessed against the six design requirements as not satisfied, partially satisfied or satisfied.
blocks.zh: 图8:根据六项设计要求评估的四座建筑中的每一座建筑均未满足、部分满足或满足。

blocks.en: 6.1 Prototype overview
blocks.zh: 6.1 原型概述

blocks.en: Prototype 0 was a feasibility build, used to develop the manufacturing skills later builds would need and to confirm that the equipment could be mounted on the Hunter 2.0 base. It is discussed below only where it partially satisfied a requirement.
blocks.zh: 原型0是一种可行性建造,用于开发后来建造的制造技能,并证实设备可以安装在Hunter 2.0基地上。 下文仅讨论部分满足要求的情况。

blocks.en: Prototype 1 was the first build to integrate the main subsystems: the Hunter 2.0 base, the Z1 arm, two OS1-32 LiDARs, the Duro GNSS receiver and a control laptop. Its main advance was independence from external power, through the two independently powered enclosures. It was never deployed in the field: bench assembly and laboratory testing showed that it failed a requirement. From then on, every build was modelled in CAD and tested in simulation before construction, so that such problems were found before anything was manufactured.
blocks.zh: 原型1是将主要的子系统整合起来的第一座建筑:猎人2.0基地,Z1臂,两个OS1-32 LiDARs,Duro GNSS接收器和一个控制笔记本电脑. 其主要进展是通过两个独立供电的封闭装置摆脱外部势力。 它从未部署在外地:长椅组装和实验室测试显示它没有达到要求。 从那时起,每座建筑都是在CAD中建模,并在建造前进行模拟测试,这样在制造任何东西之前就发现了这样的问题.

blocks.en: ALFRED was the first build to meet every requirement at least partially and the first to be used in field experiments. The main change was a modular frame of aluminium profile struts (Figure 9 ).
blocks.zh: ALFRED是第一个满足至少部分要求的建筑,也是第一个用于实地实验的建筑. 主要变化是铝质剖面结构的模块化框架(图9).

blocks.en: Figure 9 : ALFRED’s aluminium profile strut frame before panelling and components were mounted.
blocks.zh: 图9:ALFRED在安装面板和部件之前的铝质轮廓框架。

blocks.en: ALFRED 2.0 addressed the sensor coverage limitations that prevented the move from semi-autonomous operation to autonomous crop-row monitoring, mainly through a second frame layer, a second computer and a WiFi router.
blocks.zh: ALFRED 2.0主要通过第二帧层、第二台计算机和WiFi路由器,解决了传感器覆盖范围限制的问题,这些限制使从半自主操作转向自主的作物行监测。

blocks.en: 7 R1: Outdoor durability
blocks.zh: 7 R1: 室外耐久性

blocks.en: Prototype 1 failed R1 because of the 3D-printed cage housing its electronics enclosures (Figure 7(b) ). The cage was printed in PLA at low infill, since higher infill was prohibitively slow to print, and PLA performs poorly under sustained load and degrades with ultraviolet exposure and moisture. Several parts of the cage broke during assembly, and the rest were judged likely to fail in the field. ALFRED replaced the cage with a frame of aluminium profile struts and angle brackets. No structural element of this frame has failed in the two years since it was built. This does not prove durability, but it shows the frame was sufficient for the work performed, and the same struts were therefore used for ALFRED 2.0’s second layer. Both ALFRED and ALFRED 2.0 satisfy R1.
blocks.zh: 原型1失败了R1,因为3D打印的笼子里装有其电子闭塞(图7(b). 笼盖在人民解放军中以低填充方式打印,因为高填充速度过慢,难以打印,人民解放军在持续负载方面表现不佳,并在紫外线照射和湿度下降解. 笼盖的几个部分在组装过程中断裂,其余部分被判定很可能在野外失效. ALFRED将笼盖更换为铝质轮廓支架和角括号框. 此帧的结构元素自建成以来的两年中都没有出现故障. 这不能证明耐久性,但它表明这个框架足以完成所完成的工作,因此同样的支架被用于ALFRED 2.0的第二层. ALFRED和ALFRED2.0都满足R1.

blocks.en: 8 R2: Modularity and reconfigurability
blocks.zh: 第8条 R2: 模块化和再配置

blocks.en: Prototype 0 established the design principles for R2, chief among them a 3D-printed end-effector interface (Figure 10(a) ) that carries all the geometry needed to mate with the manipulator flange. Each new payload therefore needed only its own housing to be designed and printed, rather than the whole assembly, saving time and material (Figure 10 ). Shared interfaces later served the same purpose in software, keeping the codebase smaller and easier to maintain. The interface survived unchanged to the final design, and Prototype 0’s components could be rearranged easily, but as a non-functioning build it only partially satisfies R2.
blocks.zh: 0原型为R2确立了设计原理,其中主要有一个3D打印的末端效應器接口(图10(a)),它搭载了与操纵方阵交配所需的所有几何. 因此,每个新的有效载荷只需要自己的舱室来设计和打印,而不是整个组装,节省时间和材料(图10)。 共享接口后来在软件中服务于同样的目的,使代码库保持较小,更便于维护. 接口在最终设计中未变,原型0的组件很容易被重排,但作为非功能的构造它只能部分满足R2.

blocks.en: (a) End-effector interface.
blocks.zh: (a) 终端效应接口。

blocks.en: (b) LiDAR end effector.
blocks.zh: (b) LiDAR终端效应器。

blocks.en: (c) RGB-D end effector.
blocks.zh: (c) RGB-D端效应器。

blocks.en: (d) Combined end effector.
blocks.zh: (d) 综合终端效应器。

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Interchangeable sensor mounts, each built on the common manipulator interface.
blocks.zh: 图10:可互换的传感器挂载,每架安装在普通操纵器接口上.

blocks.en: Prototype 1 also only partially satisfies R2, because it lacked mounting space. The exposed profile strut on the Hunter 2.0 offers little area for the number of components the platform carries, so the printed enclosure cages were stacked vertically with the laptop on a printed rail above them. Components could be rearranged only within tight constraints, there was no room for additional hardware, and the enclosures could not be reached in the field without partial disassembly.
blocks.zh: 原型1也仅部分满足R2,因为它缺乏上升空间. Hunter 2.0上暴露的剖面图结构为平台携带的组件数量提供了很少的面积,因此印刷的封装笼与笔记本电脑垂直堆放在上面的印刷栏杆上. 部件只能在严格的限制下才能重新安排,没有增加硬件的空间,如果不进行部分拆卸,就无法到达外地。

blocks.en: ALFRED’s aluminium frame extended the mounting area beyond the footprint of the base. Laser-cut acrylic panels converted it into two housings for the electronics enclosures, each behind a hinged, latched door that gives access in the field (Figure 11 ). ALFRED 2.0 extended the same strut design with a second layer to carry the additional hardware for the ROWCAST experiments.
blocks.zh: ALFRED的铝制框架将隆起区域扩大到基地的足迹之外。 激光切割丙烯板将其转换成电子闭合器的两个掩体,每个闭合器都位于一个可进入现场的系链式,系紧的门后(图11)。 ALFRED 2.0以第二层扩展了相同的支架设计,为ROWCAST实验携带额外的硬件.

blocks.en: Figure 11 : ALFRED with a hinged door open, giving field access to an electronics enclosure.
blocks.zh: 图11: ALFRED,开着一个锁门,使外地能够访问电子封装。

blocks.en: 8.1 Reconfiguration during the ForestYear3D campaign
blocks.zh: 8.1 森林年3D运动期间的重新配置

blocks.en: The strongest evidence for R2 is that, during a year of monthly forest surveys, ALFRED was repeatedly reconfigured for another researcher’s study and for the development of ALFRED 2.0 without missing a scheduled collection. Two months into the campaign, the platform was reconfigured to study predicting added payload mass and classifying manoeuvres from the base’s battery-current response. The manipulator was replaced with a cage carrying weights, and an alternative GNSS receiver was fitted using a bespoke adapter (Figure 12 ). Each reconfiguration took about half a day in each direction.
blocks.zh: R2最强的证据是,在一年的月度森林调查中,ALFRED被反复重组,用于另一位研究人员的研究和ALFRED 2.0的开发,而没有遗漏预定的收藏. 两个月后,对平台进行了重新配置,以研究预测增加的有效载荷质量,并对基地电池电流反应中的机动性进行分类。 操纵器被更换为带重的笼子,并安装了另一台全球导航卫星系统接收器,使用一个调音器(图12)。 每次重组每个方向需要大约半天时间。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : ALFRED reconfigured for the concurrent payload study, with the manipulator replaced by a weight cage and an alternative GNSS receiver fitted.
blocks.zh: 图12:为同时进行的有效载荷研究重新配置了ALFRED,操纵器被一个重笼和一个替代的全球导航卫星系统接收器取代。

blocks.en: This period also exposed an early fault. In August 2025, the printed camera housings were found to restrict airflow enough for the RGB-D cameras to overheat during extended operation. Both the fixed and end-effector mounts were redesigned with ventilation openings (Figure 13 ). The thermal improvement was not quantified, but the fault did not recur, and finding it early meant it was resolved before the ROWCAST experiments.
blocks.zh: 这一时期也暴露了早期的过失. 2025年8月,发现印刷的相机外壳限制了足够RGB-D相机在延长操作期间过热的空气流. 固定式和末端效应架都重新设计了通风口(图13)。 热改进没有量化,但断层没有重现,发现早期意味着在ROWCAST实验之前就解决了.

blocks.en: (a) Vented fixed-camera mount.
blocks.zh: (a) 通风固定摄像机架。

blocks.en: (b) Vented end-effector mount.
blocks.zh: (b) 通风终端效应器挂载。

blocks.en: Figure 13 : RGB-D mounts redesigned with ventilation after the cameras overheated during extended operation.
blocks.zh: 图13:在延长操作期间摄像头过热后,经过通风重新设计的RGB-D挂载。

blocks.en: Because ALFRED 2.0 was developed before the ForestYear3D campaign ended, the platform switched repeatedly between the two builds, and each complete transition took about six hours. These transitions were not purely mechanical. Each build has its own robot description, collision matrix, sensor frames and inertial properties, and a platform launched against the wrong description will run but behave incorrectly, which can be dangerous. The same risk exists within a build: ALFRED 2.0 can be fitted with or without the arm-mounted LiDAR, and the controller must be updated for the change in payload. A mechanically modular platform is therefore only modular if its software model tracks its mechanical state, and this coupling is where modularity leaks. With both hardware and software kept in step through these transitions, ALFRED and ALFRED 2.0 satisfy R2.
blocks.zh: 因为阿尔弗雷德 2.0在森林年3D运动结束前开发,平台在两座建筑之间反复切换,每个完整的过渡需要约6小时. 这些过渡并非纯粹是机械的。 每个建筑都有自己的机器人描述,碰撞矩阵,传感器帧和惯性属性,针对错误描述而发射的平台会运行但行为不正确,这可能很危险. 建筑内部也存在同样的风险:ALFRED 2.0可以安装或没有臂载的LiDAR,控制器必须更新以适应有效载荷的变化. 因此,一个机械模块化的平台只有在其软件模型跟踪其机械状态时才具有模块化功能,这种耦合就是模块化泄漏的地方. 由于硬件和软件都保持了这些过渡的步调,ALFRED和ALFRED2.0满足了R2.

blocks.en: 9 R3: Repairability
blocks.zh: 9 R3:可修理性

blocks.en: Prototype 0 partially satisfies R3: every component was made in-house by 3D printing or laser cutting, and the end-effector interface (Section 8 ) means a broken mount can be replaced without reprinting the interface.
blocks.zh: 原型0部分满足R3:每个组件都是通过3D打印或激光切割在内部制成的,最终效果器接口(第8节)意味着一个破损的挂载可以不重印接口而替换.

blocks.en: Prototype 1’s power system was designed for repairability. The base can supply power directly, but unregulated, and designing a single integrated distribution system needed electronics experience that was not available at the time. Separate enclosures with their own batteries and step-down converters were adopted instead, trading mass and efficiency for the ability to build, debug and replace each supply independently. This trade is typical of the whole platform: where the optimal solution and the repairable one conflicted, the repairable one was chosen.
blocks.zh: 原型1的动力系统设计为可修复性. 该基地可以直接提供电力,但不受管制,设计单一的综合分配系统需要当时没有的电子经验。 取而代之的是分别装有自己的电池和逐步减少的转换器的封闭装置,以交换质量和效率,从而能够独立地建造、调试和替换每个供应。 这种交易是整个平台的典型:在其中,最佳解决方案和可修复的解决方案相互冲突,选择了可修复的解决方案.

blocks.en: Prototype 1’s printed cage, however, meant it only partially satisfied R3. The first design (Figure 14(a) ) was over-engineered, inspired by Japanese wood joinery for its elegance rather than any property the platform needed, and was slow to model and slower to print. The lesson is one the iterative approach is meant to surface: effort spent perfecting a subsystem before the platform exists is spent against assumptions rather than observed requirements. The simpler second design (Figure 14(b) ) was printed in PLA at low infill to reduce print times, and, as described in Section 7 , many parts broke during assembly. Although each part could be reprinted in a single working day, this could cost a scheduled collection, particularly in months with two collections, and a shared material weakness makes several parts likely to fail together. The immediate response was to switch from PLA to PETG, which is less brittle and more tolerant of outdoor exposure ( Sedlak et al., 2023 ) .The more important conclusion was that the load-bearing structure should not be printed at all.
blocks.zh: 然而,原型1的印刷笼意味着它只部分满足R3. 第一个设计(图14(a))是过度设计的,灵感来自日本木偶的优雅,而不是平台所需的任何属性,而且模拟速度缓慢,印刷速度较慢. 教训是,迭代方法意在浮出水面:在平台存在之前,为了完善一个子系统而付出的努力是针对假设而不是观测到的要求。 简便的第二套设计(图14(b))在PLA中以低填充方式印刷,以减少印刷时间,如第7节所述,许多部件在装配过程中断裂. 虽然每一部分可以在一个工作日内重印,但这可能需要预定的藏品,特别是在有两本藏品的几个月内,而且共用材料的缺陷使得几个部分有可能一起失败。 立即的反应是从人民解放军转向PETG,后者不太脆弱,更容忍室外接触(Sedlak等人,2023年)。 更重要的结论是,装货结构根本不应印刷。

blocks.en: (a) First design.
blocks.zh: (a) 第一项设计。

blocks.en: (b) Second design.
blocks.zh: (b) 第二个设计。

blocks.en: Figure 14 : CAD designs for Prototype 1’s 3D-printed cage housing the electronics enclosures.
blocks.zh: 图14:原型1的3D打印笼的CAD设计,内置电子封装.

blocks.en: ALFRED’s frame is built from stock materials. The profile strut is bought by the metre and cut to length with a hacksaw, bench vice and file, and the acrylic panels are laser-cut from sheet held in stock, so a damaged strut or panel can be replaced in minutes rather than a working day of printing. Both field builds were repaired without disrupting their schedules. During the ForestYear3D campaign, the combined RGB-D and LiDAR end-effector mount was damaged and replaced the following day, with no effect on data collection. On ALFRED 2.0, a loose power connector intermittently cut supply to the new switch and router; it was replaced with a threaded connector and the fault did not recur. Both ALFRED and ALFRED 2.0 therefore satisfy R3.
blocks.zh: ALFRED的车架由库存材料建造。 剖面板由米购买,并用黑锯,长凳副片与文件切成长度,丙烯板从库存的单片中激光切割,因此损坏的裁面板或面板可以在几分钟内更换,而不是工作日打印. 这两座野外建筑均在未中断时间表的情况下修复。 在森林年3D运动期间,RGB-D和LiDAR结合的终端效应器上架受损,并于次日更换,对数据收集没有影响. 在ALFRED2.0上,一个松散的电源连接器断断续续地切断了对新开关和路由器的供给;它被换成了线形连接器,断层没有发生. 因此,ALFRED和ALFRED2.0都满足R3.

blocks.en: 10 R4: Sensing reach and coverage
blocks.zh: 10 R4: 遥感范围和覆盖范围

blocks.en: R4 has two parts: the frame-mounted LiDAR must keep enough visibility for each experiment, and the manipulator must be able to place an end-effector-mounted sensor at poses the frame-mounted sensors cannot reach. Each complete build is assessed against both using its robot description (Figure 15 ). Meshes for the commercial base, manipulator and sensors come from manufacturer models, and those for the bespoke parts and the aluminium frame were exported from the CAD used to build them. The comparisons therefore test every build under identical assumptions, but they do not characterise field accuracy: cable routing and small fasteners are not modelled, so all three collision models are slightly optimistic.
blocks.zh: R4有两个部分:帧载LiDAR必须为每个实验保持足够的能见度,操纵者必须能够将一个端效载感应器放置在帧载感应器无法到达的位置上. 每个完整的建筑都使用其机器人描述来进行评估(图15)。 用于商业基础、操纵器和传感器的元件来自制造商模型,用于标语部件和铝框的元件则来自制造这些元件的CAD出口。 因此,比较在相同的假设下测试每个构件,但是它们并没有定性场的准确性:电缆的路由和小的紧固器没有建模,因此所有三种碰撞模型都略为乐观.

blocks.en: 10.1 Fixed-sensor visibility
blocks.zh: 10.1 固定传感器可见度

blocks.en: The two experiments place different demands on the frame-mounted LiDAR. In ForestYear3D, the robot traverses a forest corridor with the vegetation of interest to either side, and an operator steers, so transverse visibility matters more than longitudinal visibility. In ROWCAST, ALFRED 2.0 drives autonomously. An Ackermann-steered vehicle can only move along its longitudinal axis, with steering changing only the curvature, so self-occlusion to the front or rear hides the region the platform will enter next and matters more than the same occlusion at an oblique bearing.
blocks.zh: 两次实验对装帧的LiDAR提出了不同的要求. 在Forest Year3D中,机器人通过森林走廊,其中任何一方都感兴趣的植被,操作员驾驶,因此,横向可见度比纵向可见度更重要。 在ROWCAST中,ALFRED 2.0驱动器自主驱动. Ackermann型蒸汽机车只能沿其纵向轴向移动,转向架仅改变曲面,因此自闭式到前部或后部隐藏区域,平台将进入下一个区域,在斜面轴承上比同一闭式更重要.

Rays were cast at 1,024 azimuths up to a 5 m 5\text{\,}\mathrm{m} cap and intersected with an analytical ground plane and the posed visual meshes, rather than the simplified collision primitives used for planning. Azimuth 0 ° 0\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} is the robot’s forward direction. blocks.en: The results are shown in Figure 17 and Table 2 . On ALFRED, arm posture matters: the clear share of the horizontal beam rises from 74.80% with the arm at zero to 88.96% in the drive posture. On ALFRED 2.0 the two postures give identical results, because the arm no longer crosses the sensor’s horizontal plane, and removing this dependence on posture is useful in its own right. Prototype 1’s sensor is pitched, so its near-horizontal beam meets the ground across the whole forward sector at 1.41 m 1.41\text{\,}\mathrm{m} . Its results are a mount-specific reference rather than a like-for-like comparison, showing that an inclined mount gives up visibility in the lower beams for clearer visibility in the upper ones.
blocks.zh: 结果见图17和表2。 在ALFRED上,手臂姿态很重要:水平梁的清晰比例从74.80%,手臂在驱动姿态中为0,上升到88.96%. 在ALFRED 2.0上,这两种姿势给出了相同的结果,因为手臂不再跨越传感器的水平平面,消除这种对姿势的依赖本身是有用的. 原型1的传感器被投放,所以它的近横向束在1.41 m 1.41\text ~, → mathrm{m} 整个前方区间与地面相接。 其结果是一个挂载特定参照物,而不是类似比较,表明倾斜的挂载放弃了下梁的可见度,以便在上梁更清晰的可见度.

blocks.en: For ForestYear3D, where transverse visibility matters most, no build’s lowest beam reaches the 5 m 5\text{\,}\mathrm{m} cap. In the horizontal beam, ALFRED in the drive posture used during the campaign gives the widest transverse aperture of any configuration, at 160.31 ° 160.31\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} to the left and 159.96 ° 159.96\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} to the right. ALFRED also far outperforms ALFRED 2.0 in the highest beam (92.97% clear against 36.33%), which matters because ForestYear3D aims to capture as much of each tree’s height as possible, although Prototype 1’s pitched sensor performs best in this beam.
blocks.zh: Foresty Year3D在反向可见度最重要的地方, 在水平波束中,运动中使用的驱动姿势中的ALFRED给出了任意配置的最宽横孔,左侧为160.31° 160.31\text\,左侧为Q}\mathrm\SI UnitSymbolDegree},右侧为159.96° 159.96\text\,右侧为X}\mathrm\SI UnitSymbolDegree}. ALFRED在最高光束中也远超ALFRED 2.0(92.97%清晰,36.33%清晰),这很重要,因为Forest Year3D旨在尽可能多地捕捉每棵树的高度,尽管原型1的投放传感器在这个光束中表现最好。

blocks.en: For ROWCAST, the key measure is horizontal-beam visibility along the longitudinal axis. ALFRED 2.0 is the only build whose horizontal beam reaches the cap in these directions, with 56.60 ° 56.60\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} of clear aperture to the front and 22.50 ° 22.50\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} to the rear. This is a redistribution rather than a uniform gain: ALFRED 2.0’s remaining occlusions flank the longitudinal axis rather than crossing it, and its upper layer trades upper-beam coverage for centreline visibility. The analysis is static and assumes flat ground, so it locates the self-occluded regions but not how long an obstacle stays hidden while the robot moves. Answering that would require simulating the sensor’s view through realistic turns at a range of speeds and steering angles.
blocks.zh: 对ROWCAST来说,关键衡量标准是纵向轴上水平束可见度. ALFRED 2.0是唯一一个水平梁达到这些方向的建筑,其前方有清晰孔径的56.60°56.60\text~,前方有QQMATHRM~SI UnitSymbolDegree~,后方有22.50°22.50\text~,XMATHRM~SI UnitSymbolDegree~. 这是重新分配,而不是统一收益: ALFRED 2.0 的余下封存在纵向轴上而不是横跨纵向轴上,其上层交易上梁覆盖中线可见度. 分析是静态的,假设是平地的,因此它定位的是自闭区域,而不是机器人移动时隐藏障碍的时间. 回答这个问题需要通过现实的转弯以各种速度和方向角度模拟传感器的视野。

blocks.en: 10.2 Manipulator workspace
blocks.zh: 10.2 操纵工作空间

blocks.en: To test the manipulator’s ability to place sensors at poses the frame-mounted sensors cannot reach, each build was evaluated on a common lattice of 3 110 400 3\,110\,400 end-effector poses: 1,800 translations at 0.2 m 0.2\text{\,}\mathrm{m} spacing relative to the manipulator base, each with 1,728 orientations sampled at 30 ° 30\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} intervals in roll, pitch and yaw (Figure 18 ). Because translations are expressed relative to the manipulator base rather than the vehicle, all three builds are tested at identical poses relative to the arm.
blocks.zh: 为了测试操纵者将传感器放置在帧式传感器上的能力无法达到,每个构件被评价在3 110 400 3\ 110\ 400 终端效应器的普通衬垫上:1 800 个翻译,翻译时间为 0.2\ text~, + mathrm{ m} 相对于操纵者底部, 每一个在 30 ° 30\ text~, + mathrm\ SI UnitSymbol Degree} 间隔在卷、 投和 yaw (图 18) 中抽取1 728个方向。 因为翻译是相对于操纵器基础而不是车辆来表达的,所以所有这三栋建筑都以与臂部相同的姿势进行测试.

blocks.en: Figure 18 : Reachability lattice, with each translation coloured by the number of orientations with a valid inverse kinematics solution.
blocks.zh: 图18:可达性纹章,每个译名的颜色为方向数,具有有效的反动性解.

blocks.en: Inverse kinematics was attempted for each target from eight fixed seeds. A solution was accepted only if it converged to within 2 mm 2\text{\,}\mathrm{mm} and 0.5 ° 0.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} and was collision-free under the build’s own collision model. Because the manipulator uses relative encoders, its initial pose can be slightly off, so two safety margins were added: a 0.10 m 0.10\text{\,}\mathrm{m} clearance between the arm and the rest of the robot, and joint limits inset by 0.23 rad 0.23\text{\,}\mathrm{rad} . As the search is finite, a failure means no admissible configuration was found within the budget, not that none exists, so absolute figures are lower bounds. The comparison holds because the lattice, budget and tolerances are identical across builds.
blocks.zh: 从8个固定种子中,每个目标都尝试过反动。 只有在2mm 2\text\, }\mathrm{mm} 和 0.5° 0. 5\text\, }\mathrm\ SI UnitSymbol Degree ) 内汇合且在建筑本身的碰撞模型下无碰撞的情况下, 由于操纵器使用相对编码器,其初始姿势可以略微脱落,因此增加了两个安全边:臂与机器人其余部分之间的0.10 m 0.10\text~,}\mathrm{m}清除,以及0.23 rad 0.23\text~,}\mathrm{rad}设置的联合限制. 由于搜索是有限的,失败意味着在预算范围内没有找到可允许的配置,而不是不存在,因此绝对数字的界限较低. 比较之所以如此,是因为建筑物的装饰、预算和容忍度是相同的。

blocks.en: Most of the lattice lies beyond the manipulator’s 740 mm 740\text{\,}\mathrm{mm} reach, so the informative denominator is the set of poses at which inverse kinematics converged. This set is almost identical across builds (Table 3 ); Prototype 1’s slightly larger set reflects its different end-effector mount, which places the wrist differently for the same sensor pose. Of these reachable poses, 34.0% are usable on Prototype 1, 60.0% on ALFRED and 66.1% on ALFRED 2.0. The strut frame therefore increased the usable workspace by a factor of about 1.8, and the upper layer added a further six percentage points.
blocks.zh: 大部分的纹饰都位于操纵者的740mm 740\text~,\\ mathrm{mm} 到达范围之外,所以信息分母是反动体聚集的一组姿势. 这一组几乎完全相同(表3);原型1的稍大一些的一组反映了其不同的终端效应器挂载,使手腕对同一传感器的姿势不同。 其中34.0%可用于原型1,60.0%用于ALFRED,66.1%用于ALFRED2.0。 因此,结构框架使可用工作空间增加了约1.8个百分点,上层增加了6个百分点。

blocks.en: The gain comes from fewer collisions. Collision rejections fall from 50.8% of reachable poses on Prototype 1 to 17.6% on ALFRED and 13.3% on ALFRED 2.0, while the number of collision pairs falls from 128 to 102 to 84, showing that structure was removed from around the arm rather than rearranged. Figure 19 shows the same trend spatially: Prototype 1 retains at least one orientation at 103 of the 1,800 translation cells, against 157 and 161 for the later builds, and its best cell admits 184 orientations against 290. The later builds therefore reach more positions and admit more orientations at each.
blocks.zh: 收益来自较少的碰撞. 拒绝碰撞者从原型1的50.8%可接触面降至ALFRED的17.6%和ALFRED 2.0的13.3%,而碰撞对的数量则从128对降至102对至84对,表明结构是从手臂周围移走而不是重新排列的. 图19显示了同样的空间趋势: 原型1保留了1800个翻译细胞中103个至少一个方向,而后期建筑则保留157个和161个方向,其最好的细胞承认了184个方向对290个方向. 因此,后一个阶段将形成更多的立场,并承认每个阶段都有更多的方向。

blocks.en: Prototype 1’s cluttered frame limits its usable workspace to 34% of reachable poses despite moderate visibility, so it partially satisfies R4. ALFRED and ALFRED 2.0 both perform well in reachability, and each has visibility suited to its experiment, so both satisfy R4.
blocks.zh: 原型1的杂交框架尽管能见度中等,但将其可用工作空间限制在可达面额的34%,因此部分满足R4. ALFRED和ALFRED 2.0两者在可达性上都表现良好,每个都具有适合其实验的能见度,因此都满足R4.

blocks.en: 10.3 R5: Endurance

Prototype 1 was never tested in the field, but it used the same two independently powered enclosures later deployed on ALFRED, so it receives the same rating: partially satisfied. ALFRED only partially satisfies R5 because, around December 2025, one of its two batteries degraded significantly. Each charge then lasted about 30 min 30\text{\,}\mathrm{min} , or roughly five of the 33 corridor traversals in a complete survey window, so a window that had taken one day to collect took three. Winter made this worse, since trials cannot run in rain or strong wind and collection days were already scarce. A replacement 48 V 48\text{\,}\mathrm{V} 30 A h 30\text{\,}\mathrm{A}\text{\,}\mathrm{h} lithium-ion battery and a portable generator were obtained, so R5 was restored by new equipment part-way through the campaign rather than by a new build. ALFRED 2.0 used both from the start and satisfies R5.
blocks.zh: 原型1从未在野外进行测试,但后来在ALFRED上使用了相同的两个独立电源的封装装置,因此获得了相同的评分:部分满足. ALFRED仅部分满足R5,因为2025年12月前后,其两个电池组之一严重退化. 每条电荷持续了大约30分钟 30\ text ~, ~ mathrm{min} 或大约5条33条走廊的转弯 在一个完整的勘测窗口, 所以一个窗口花了一天的时间收集了3个。 冬季使情况更加恶化,因为无法在雨中或强风中进行审判,收集时间已经不多。 48 V 48\text~,}\mathrm{V}30 Ah 30\text~,}\mathrm{A}\text→,}\mathrm{h}锂离子电池和一个便携式发电机被获得,因此R5通过运动中的新设备分路恢复,而不是通过新建筑恢复. ALFRED 2.0从一开始就使用,并满足了R5.

blocks.en: 10.4 R6: Reproducibility by others
blocks.zh: 10.4 R6:他人可复制

blocks.en: The platform is released in full at https://github.com/CiaranJohnson/ALFRED . The release includes the source CAD for every bespoke component; the robot descriptions and collision configurations used in Section 10 ; and code for operating the platform in simulation and on hardware. The software is packaged in Docker containers so it runs independently of the host environment, an implementation manual covers assembly and bring-up, and the bill of materials in A lists every commercial component with its cost. Prototype 1’s robot description is included, but as that build was never deployed, no operating code exists for it, so it partially satisfies R6. ALFRED and ALFRED 2.0 are fully reproducible from the release and satisfy R6.
blocks.zh: 该平台在https://github.com/CiaranJohnson/ALFRED上全文发布. 。 。 。 发布内容包括每个铃声组件的源CAD;第10节中使用的机器人描述和碰撞配置;以及在模拟和硬件上操作平台的代码. 该软件在Docker容器中包装,因此它独立于主机环境运行,执行手册涵盖装配和提携,A中的材料单列出每个商业组件及其成本. 原型1的机器人描述被包含在内,但由于该构件从未部署过,因此它不存在操作代码,因此它部分满足了R6. ALFRED和ALFRED2.0从发布中完全可以复制,满足了R6.

blocks.en: 11 Discussion, Limitations and Research Opportunities
blocks.zh: 11 讨论、限制和研究机会

blocks.en: The requirements set out in Section 5 were met in service rather than in demonstration. ALFRED completed a year of monthly forest surveys, 528 traversals across 29 days, without missing a scheduled collection, while the platform was also reconfigured for a concurrent payload study and while ALFRED 2.0 was being built and tested alongside it. Iterating against explicit requirements is what made that possible: each rebuild was directed at a specific shortcoming of its predecessor, and the effect is measurable. The usable share of the arm’s reachable workspace rose from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, the collision pairs the model must check fell from 128 to 84, and only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR’s view clear along both directions of travel. Because both comparisons were made on the robot descriptions, the consequence of a proposed change can be quantified before anything is manufactured. This is the most transferable result of the work, and with the design files, robot description and containers released, the same comparison can be run on other platforms. The remainder of this section sets out what the deployment record shows about the limits inherited from the commercial hardware, the integration effort the platform required, and the proposing future work.
blocks.zh: 第5节中规定的要求是在服役中而不是在示威中得到满足的。 ALFRED完成了一年的月度森林调查,历时29天共528次,没有遗漏预定的收集,而该平台也被重新配置,以便同时进行有效载荷研究,同时ALFRED 2.0正在同时建造和测试。 与明确要求相对应的是促成这一点的原因:每次重建都针对其前身的具体缺陷,其效果是可衡量的。 手臂可伸缩工作空间的可用份额从34.0%升至60.0%,然后升至66.1%,碰撞对对必须检查模型从128跌至84,只有最后的建筑才能使装帧的LiDAR在双向旅行中保持清晰的视野。 由于两次都对机器人描述进行了比较,因此在制造任何东西之前,可以量化拟议变化的后果。 这是工作最可转移的结果,随着设计文件,机器人描述和容器的发布,可以在其他平台上进行同样的比较. 本节其余部分阐述了部署记录对商业硬件继承的限度、平台所需的整合努力以及未来拟议工作的说明。

blocks.en: 11.1 Hardware

There are two major limitations firstly the chassis is rated to IP22 unless purchased with custom ingress protection, and the manual states explicitly that it is not waterproof and should not be operated in rain or snow; this is why collection was not attempted in wet conditions. Secondly, the arm uses relative encoders and must be placed in the zero position prior to power on. This results in joint offsets, this error can propagate into sensor measurements.
blocks.zh: 有两个主要限制,首先是底盘被评为IP22,除非使用定制的入侵保护购买,手册明确规定它不防水,不应该在雨或雪中操作;这就是为什么在湿的条件下没有尝试收集. 第二,臂部使用相对编码器,在开启动力前必须置于零位置. 这导致联合抵消,这个错误可以传播到传感器测量中.

blocks.en: 11.2 Integration is the hidden cost
blocks.zh: 11.2 整合是隐藏成本

blocks.en: The substantive engineering effort lay in making the commercial hardware and open-source software work together. Modifications to third-party code were needed, to integrate the various components of the robot. The most consequential was a mismatch between the LiDAR driver’s packet structure and that expected from FAST-LIO2. Another significant modification is the base does not expose a joint state interface on the physical hardware: it reports only a rear-wheel linear velocity and a central steering angle, so the positions of the steering and wheel joints are unknown to the rest of the system and the robot model cannot be posed. Without them there is no complete transform tree, and consequently no way to view the LiDAR and camera output in its correct spatial relationship to the robot; this removes the most direct means of checking, live or from a recording, that the sensors are seeing what they are believed to be seeing. A hardware interface was added within the vendor package to reconstruct the joint states from the reported velocity and steering angle using the platform’s Ackermann geometry, resolving per-wheel steering angles from the lateral distance to the instantaneous centre of rotation and per-wheel speeds from their respective path radii. This also reconciles the simulator, whose model is Ackermann, with the hardware, which reports according to a bicycle model, so that one visualisation serves both.
blocks.zh: 实质性的工程工作在于使商业硬件和开放源码软件共同发挥作用。 需要修改第三方代码,以整合机器人的各种组件。 最直接的后果是,LiDAR驱动程序包结构与FAST-LIO2的预期结构不匹配。 另一个显著的修改是基座没有暴露物理硬件上的联合状态接口:它只报告后轮线性速度和中央转向角,因此系统其他部分不知道方向盘和轮关节的位置,机器人模型无法摆设. 没有它们,就没有完整的变换树,因此无法查看LiDAR和相机输出与机器人的正确空间关系;这消除了最直接的检查,直播或录音的方法,传感器正在看到他们相信看到的东西. 在供应商包内增加了一个硬件接口,利用平台的Ackermann几何技术,从报告的速度和方向角度重建联合状态,从横向距离到瞬间旋转中心解决每轮方向角度,从各自路径径向解决每轮速度。 这也调和了模拟器,其型号为Ackermann,与硬件,硬件按照自行车模型进行报告,这样一款可视化就同时服务于两者.

blocks.en: 11.3 Future Work
blocks.zh: 11.3 今后的工作

blocks.en: ALFRED 2.0 was initially intended to support online next-best-view planning in which the robot would observe the current scene, select an informative sensor pose, generate a collision-free whole-body motion and execute that motion before repeating the process. Such an architecture would allow the robot to adapt its sensing trajectory to the vegetation present during each visit rather than relying on viewpoints selected in advance. Several planning and control approaches were implemented towards this objective.
blocks.zh: 萨尔瓦多 2.0最初旨在支持在线的近景规划,其中机器人将观测当前场景,选择信息感应姿势,产生无碰撞的全身运动,并在重复过程前执行该运动. 这种结构将使机器人能够使其感知轨迹适应每次访问时的植被,而不是依赖事先选定的观点。 为实现这一目标,实施了若干规划和控制办法。

blocks.en: The initial architecture adapted an existing mobile-manipulator next-best-view framework to the ALFRED platform. A live occupancy representation was constructed from the frame-mounted and arm-mounted LiDAR measurements. Candidate sensor poses were sampled around the observed scene and evaluated by casting rays into the occupancy map to estimate how much previously unobserved space would become visible. Candidate poses were then tested for inverse-kinematic feasibility, self-collision and collision with the mapped environment. The intended output was a sensor pose that was both reachable and expected to increase the observed volume.
blocks.zh: 最初的架构将现有的移动操纵器后续最佳视野框架改编为ALFRED平台. 根据立方架和臂架的LiDAR测量结果,建造了现场占用代表。 在观测到的场景周围对候选传感器的姿势进行了取样,并将射线投射到占用图中加以评估,以估计以前未观测到的空间会有多少可见。 然后对候选姿势进行反相可行性、自我碰撞和与绘图环境碰撞的测试。 预定的输出是传感器的姿势,既可以达到,又预期会增加观测到的体积。

blocks.en: The motion required to reach the selected pose was represented as a whole-body path containing the planar vehicle pose and the six manipulator joint positions. Early implementations used sampling-based planning with Reeds–Shepp connections for the base and separate inverse kinematics for the manipulator. A subsequent implementation used a local quadratic programme to steer a search tree through the combined base-arm configuration space. The quadratic programme selected a signed base velocity, steering change and six joint velocities to reduce the error to a sampled whole-body state while respecting steering, joint-position and joint-velocity limits. While also being collision-free with itself and the environment. The issue with this approach is the time required to generate the next motion depended strongly on the scene, the sampled candidates and the number of rejected paths and could grow extremely large.
blocks.zh: 达到所选姿势所需的运动是作为包含平面飞行器姿势和6个操纵器联合姿势的全体路径来代表的. 早期实施时采用了与Reeds-Shepp连接的抽样规划,为基底和操纵者分别使用反动动因。 随后的执行使用一个局部四极程序引导搜索树穿过组合基臂配置空间. 四重奏方案选择了一个签名的基座速度,方向变化和6个联动速度,在尊重方向,联动位置和联动速度限制的情况下,将误差降低到一个抽样的全体状态. 同时也与自身及环境无碰撞. 这种办法的问题是,产生下一个动议所需的时间在很大程度上取决于现场、抽样候选人和被拒绝路径的数量,而且可能变得非常大。

blocks.en: A kinematic whole-body model-predictive controller (MPC) was developed to track the resulting base-arm trajectories. The vehicle was represented using an Ackermann bicycle model and the manipulator joints were propagated using first-order kinematics. The MPC introduced a segmented path-progress tracker to avoid cutting corners in both the base and the manipulator. However all attempts encountered difficulties at transitions between forward and reverse motion and struggled to generalise well to all scenarios.
blocks.zh: 开发了一个运动全体模型预测控制器(MPC),以跟踪由此产生的基臂轨迹. 该车使用Ackermann自行车模型作为代表,操纵关节则使用一阶动能进行推广. MPC引入了一条分割路径进度跟踪器,以避免在基座和操纵器中都切割角. 然而,所有尝试都遇到了前向运动和逆向运动之间的过渡方面的困难,并努力对所有情况都加以概括。

blocks.en: Online collision checking also depended on constructing a sufficiently consistent representation of the changing scene. ALFRED 2.0 update it’s representation of the environment using both the base- and arm-mounted LiDARs. Separate self-filters were required because each sensor observed different parts of the robot. Their filtered measurements were then combined for insertion into an OctoMap used by the planner and collision checker. This pipeline was sensitive to the consistency of the point-cloud timestamp, transform tree and self-filter geometry. Inaccuracies in any of these could result in the robot adding part of itself to the OctoMap. The collision checker could then report a collision between the robot and a structure generated by the robot itself. Increasing the filtered volume reduced this risk but also removed legitimate environmental measurements close to the platform.
blocks.zh: 在线碰撞检查还取决于如何充分连贯地反映不断变化的场景。 ALFRED 2.0更新了它使用基座和臂载的LiDARs来表达环境. 由于每个传感器都观测到机器人的不同部分,因此需要单独的自过滤器. 然后将它们的滤波测量结果合并起来,插入规划者和碰撞检查器使用的OctoMap中。 这条输油管对点-云时标、变形树和自过滤几何学的一致性十分敏感。 其中任何一个的不精确都可能导致机器人在OctoMap中加入一部分自身. 然后碰撞检查器可以报告机器人与机器人本身产生的结构发生碰撞. 增加过滤量可降低这一风险,但也可消除靠近平台的合法环境测量。

blocks.en: Future work, would look to address these issues identified in the online planner and compare this approach to that of ROWCAST for autonomous crop row monitoring.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作是设法解决在线规划中查明的这些问题,并将这一办法与ROWCAST办法进行比较,以便进行作物排独立监测。

blocks.en: 12 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 12. 结论

blocks.en: Repeated in-field sensing demands more of a platform than a single demonstration: it must tolerate the weather, adapt to changing sensing tasks, be repaired between visits and last a full collection session. This paper presented ALFRED, a mobile manipulator assembled from commercially available components and developed through four builds against six requirements set for that purpose. The platform met them in service, completing a year of monthly forest surveys (528 traversals over 29 days, 4.9 TB 4.9\text{\,}\mathrm{TB} of data) without missing a scheduled collection, while also being reconfigured for a concurrent payload study and rebuilt for autonomous crop-row operation, with each change of build taking about six hours. Only endurance needed intervention, restored mid-campaign by replacing a degraded battery.
blocks.zh: 重复的场内感知比单一的演示更需要一个平台:它必须容忍天气,适应不断变化的感知任务,在访问之间被修复,最后是完整的收集会. 本文介绍了ALFRED, 由商用组件组装而成的移动操纵器,通过四栋大楼开发,符合为此目的制定的六项要求。 该平台在服务中满足了他们,完成了一年的每月森林调查(29天为528次,数据为4.9 TB 4.9\text\,XQ mathrm{TB}),没有遗漏预定的收集,同时为同时进行的有效载荷研究进行了重新配置,并重建了用于自主的作物种植作业,每次改变建筑大约需要6小时。 只有耐力需要干预,通过更换退化电池恢复中场。

blocks.en: Iterating against explicit requirements produced measurable gains. Across the last three builds, the usable share of the arm’s reachable workspace rose from 34.0% to 60.0% and then 66.1%, the number of collision pairs fell from 128 to 84, and only the final build keeps the frame-mounted LiDAR’s horizontal view clear both forwards and backwards. Because both analyses run on the robot descriptions, the effect of a design change on reach and visibility can be quantified before anything is manufactured. The experience suggests three priorities for similar platforms: design for repair from the outset, treat the robot description as part of the hardware configuration, and budget for integration. The design files, robot descriptions, drivers and containers are released so that others can rebuild the platform or run the same comparisons on their own designs. Whether placing sensors with an arm improves what repeated surveys measure is the question the platform was built to answer, and the data it has already collected is where that answer will be found.
blocks.zh: 对照明确要求进行重复,产生了可衡量的成果。 在最后三座建筑中,臂可伸展的工作空间的可用份额从34.0%上升到60.0%,然后是66.1%,碰撞对的数量从128对下降到84对,只有最后一座建筑保持了帧式LiDAR横向视野的前后清晰。 由于这两种分析都运行在机器人描述上,所以在制造任何东西之前,可以量化设计变化对影响力和能见度的影响. 经验为类似平台提出了三个优先事项:从一开始就进行修复设计,将机器人描述作为硬件配置的一部分,以及整合预算. 设计文件,机器人描述,驾驶员和容器被发布,以便其他人可以重建平台或者在自己的设计上运行同样的比较. 是否将传感器放在臂部会改进反复测量的尺度是平台是用来回答的问题,它已经收集的数据就是答案所在。
